title: Netherite Armor Elytra
description: You now can craft a netherite chestplate with elytra function.
body:
In this datapack you can craft a netherite elytra.
Combine a diamond chestplate with a netherite ingot and an elytra to get it in your world.
I still am working on the item model.

Disclaimer: The item will probably keep its function even if the datapack is removed.
